body.zh: 凸点阵列需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配，芯片底部还常需要底填。图示顺序为：晶圆级凸点及凸点阵列 → 对准 → 回流或热压装配 → 底填。
body.en: Bump arrays require wafer-level bumping, alignment, and reflow or thermocompression assembly; underfill is often also needed beneath the die. The illustrated sequence is wafer-level bumping and the bump array → alignment → reflow or thermocompression assembly → underfill.

body.zh: 主剖面标出了芯片、底填与凸点。局部图分别展示对准剖面、共面性边界和底填空洞。对准图以左右箭头与虚线标示相对位置；共面性图以虚线和上下箭头标示边界；空洞图标出底填中的空洞。
body.en: The main cross-section labels the die, underfill and bumps. Enlarged views show alignment, coplanarity limits and underfill voids. Opposing arrows and dashed lines indicate relative alignment; a dashed line and vertical arrows indicate the coplanarity limit; the void illustration identifies voids in the underfill.

body.zh: 共面性要求更高 → 更易产生空洞 → 更容易翘曲 → 可靠性风险上升。翘曲与可靠性示意展示弯曲的芯片结构和可靠性问题。
body.en: Stricter coplanarity requirements → more readily formed voids → greater susceptibility to warpage → increased reliability risk. The warpage and reliability illustration shows a bowed die structure and reliability problems.

body.zh: 细间距使共面性控制更难，底填更易产生空洞，并可能引起翘曲，进而影响可靠性。
body.en: Finer pitch makes coplanarity harder to control and promotes underfill voids; it may also cause warpage and thus affect reliability.
